entries.title: Cancelling a working task ends it
entries.body: When you ask the first mate to cancel a task whose crewmate is still working, the task now closes as cancelled right away. Before, it could stay running after the first mate said it was cancelled, sometimes through a second cancel, most often for a task working on another of your computers.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen looks different: the change is that a cancelled task leaves the crew instead of staying listed as working.
